caption:
Comment BLUEPRINT and I'll send it over: the whole faceless model, written out.

Five red flags. Any one of them is your answer. You don't need a reason to walk away from an offer, you need one of these.

WHY THIS LIST EXISTS

A bad offer doesn't just underpay. It wastes the posts, the angle, and the weeks before you find out. Check the offer before you spend any of that.

FOUR RED FLAGS

1. No payout minimum listed. If they won't put the number in writing, that's not an oversight.
2. Cookie window under a day. Someone clicks today and buys next week, you get nothing.
3. Pays once, never again. Ask what happens if the customer stays a year.
4. Nobody can show you their dashboard. You're trusting a claim, not a track record.

THE ONE QUESTION

Not all four, just one. If they dodge it, you already have your answer. A program that hides its terms is telling you something about the payout, too.

THE HONEST PART

I'm not going to tell you what you'll make. I don't know you, and I don't know how hard you'll work.

It could be zero. A clean offer doesn't make anyone click it. This is a filter, not a promise.

Comment BLUEPRINT and I'll send it over.
